method: Fresh native image, 2x hand and face crops, complete arm-chain and prop-contact checks, canonical portraits, current MDX/exercise and independent 768 x 512 preview. Physical glass and content convergence assessed, allowing slope to change with row height.

checks.anatomyAndContact: Two distinct Demir shoulder-elbow-wrist chains lead to separate typing hands in front of his torso. Fingers contact the keyboard; medial far-left thumb and occluded near-right thumb are consistent with the pose.
checks.identityExpressionAndStory: Demir's focused gaze, canonical freckles, swept hair and stubble remain recognizable. The supported typing pose fits the challenge.
checks.displayLegibilityAndSource: The four raw rows [20,0.2], [22,0.8], [24,0.4], [26,0.6], batch [4,2], fit/scale/fixed-neuron flow, weights [0.9,-1.4], bias -0.3, sigmoid and pending scores [4,1] match current lesson and exercise. All remain legible at 768 x 512.
checks.perspectiveAndOperator: PASS: the glass and content horizontal families converge consistently, with upper lines rising toward the right and lower lines falling as expected around a common horizon. The title divider, raw-row table and lower pending-result band follow that family. The connected keyboard lies in front of the monitor and Demir occupies its readable front side.
checks.largeDisplayRule: Main content occupies a large working monitor and remains readable without clipped teaching text at 768 x 512.
checks.palette: Muted charcoal, sage and brass remain consistent with Deep Orbit.

measuredGeometry.interpretation: Changing slope with vertical position is expected projective convergence, not a defect.
